title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: annual aggregate on approved settlements
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs the annual aggregate that limits the settlements approved on CargoCare products. It applies whenever a claim is approved for settlement.

## Clauses in force

1. When the computed settlement would exceed the aggregate that remains available, the settlement is reduced to that remaining aggregate, and the approval records the aggregate limit as the liability measure that fixed the amount.
2. When nothing of the aggregate remains, the claim is approved at 0.00, again recording the aggregate limit as the measure, rather than rejected, because the loss is covered but the aggregate is spent.
3. Settlements under AHL Standard Carrier Liability and AHL Declared Value Liability have no aggregate.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**. They have been superseded by the current basis for settlement approvals and must not be applied to any approval:

- "CargoCare products carry an annual aggregate per cover holder." This clause is no longer in force.
- The clause that, for a product whose annual aggregate limit is above 0.00, the settlements approved on all of the cover holder's covers of that product in the trailing 365 days (a window ending on the approval date, inclusive, across every cover of the same product held by the cover holder), plus the settlement being approved, may not exceed the product's annual aggregate limit, together with the remaining aggregate measured on that trailing window, is no longer in force.

## Condition, judgement, action

| Situation at approval | Judgement | Action |
|---|---|---|
| The product is AHL Standard Carrier Liability or AHL Declared Value Liability | No aggregate applies | The settlement is not reduced under this policy |
| The computed settlement exceeds the aggregate that remains | The aggregate binds | Approve at the remaining aggregate, recording the aggregate limit |
| Nothing of the aggregate remains | The loss is covered but the aggregate is spent | Approve at 0.00, recording the aggregate limit; do not reject |

## Hypothetical worked examples

- **Example 1 (hypothetical figures):** a CargoCare claim computes to a settlement of 5,000.00 USD, and 2,000.00 USD of the aggregate remains available. The settlement is reduced to 2,000.00 USD and the approval records the aggregate limit.
- **Example 2 (hypothetical figures):** a CargoCare claim computes to 3,000.00 USD and nothing of the aggregate remains. The claim is approved at 0.00 USD with the aggregate limit recorded; it is not rejected.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* an exhausted aggregate means the claim is rejected. *Correct basis:* the claim is approved at 0.00 with the aggregate limit recorded, because the loss is covered.
